verdict.rationale: Jitsu is explicitly warehouse-native: it streams/batches events to Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, S3, GCS, Redshift, Postgres directly, auto-creates schema, supports optional batching for scheduling control, and self-hosting options (Kubernetes/on-prem) give full control over destination and timing. Profiles are also built and stored directly in the customer's warehouse. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of scheduling granularity or batch cadence beyond vendor docs.
